newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia, Canada and French TV bodies in pact.
newsitem.headline: Australia, Canada and French TV bodies in pact.

text.p: The Australian Broadcasting Authority (ABA) said on Thursday it has formalised its relations with the Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications (CRTC) and the French Conseil Superieur de l'Audiovisuel (CSA) regulatory bodies.

"The cooperation agreements will facilitate channels of communication between the ABA and the CRTC and CSA respectively, on a range of issues including local content requirements, programme content regulation and technological development such as the implications of digital television," ABA chairman Peter Webb said in a statement.
